steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: They've been the target of collusion from the very start of the event, but LUNG wRATh have once again put on a marvelous breakthrough act.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Mr. Pancho, you mentioned how this team was struggling to mesh in Round 1. What do you think of them now?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Cooperation troubles don't get resolved in one night.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: But obviously, these two know about the problem, so they've clearly divided up their combat.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: This time, it's a lot more nimble than the fighting in Round 1.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Good to know. So, does that mean their chance of victory has shot up?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Still hard to say. The other contestants'll have their own countermeasures.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: That's true. Trying to hold back LUNG wRATh normally has already proven ineffective, so let's hope the other competitors can show us some new tricks!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Heh, they're right.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And the mood between them's eased a bit too. Wonder if anything happened.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: So it comes from the Iberian period, no wonder...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm? Missy, that's not the competition. What are you looking at?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Information on this cruise ship.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's so interesting? Did you just say Iberia?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yeah. The ship's actually a relic from the age of Iberia.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That early...? Actually, thinking about it, there's no other country that would have stuff like this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And Mayor Candela paid big money to buy it off the Iberians, and for the tech to remodel it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And all this just to have the thing floating out on the city's sea.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I don't think there's another person across the whole world who'd do that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That sure is some level of luxury.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Speaking of which, Missy, weren't you looking into this Mayor the past two days? Any findings?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Findings... they're still pretty basic so far.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This Candela Sanchez, in some sense, is someone who can stand shoulder to shoulder with Chief Wei.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She's that powerful?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yeah. It's not exactly the same, but they're both completely wrapped up in their cities, and both have a tight grip on the reins of government.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: As a member of the L.G.D., I would absolutely never say I admire someone who builds a city like this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But as a daughter of the Schwire family, I have to admit, a builder like that is a real tough customer.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: If we're saying this city's base is much more solid than it seems, then its superstructure is even crazier than it seems.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Agents of three governments come flooding into this city every day, and the news will sometimes report on disputes, even small-scale conflicts, between them.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But the thing is, nobody cares.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They come here as an open secret, respect an unwritten code of conduct, and revel in a joy they could never have outside.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Can you picture it?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The first time the three sides clashed, Mayor Candela showed up for sure, and used some method we could never imagine to 'talk them over.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And after that, anyone who came to this city had to keep by the rules she set.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But I just don't know what it was. Leverage? Or a political bargaining chip?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Lady Candela has enough armed force on hand to defend this city, that's for sure.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But beyond all of that, I feel like there's a real simple answer, Missy. Haven't you already realized?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Realized what?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here's what it is—alcohol, sugar, coffee, and entertainment.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How could those things possibly...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's a time-old tale, Missy. The frugal convert to extravagance, but it's a nightmare to go the other way.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Forget old boys who've been spoiled rotten since childhood. You could even take me. If I suddenly lost something I was real used to and felt was real nice, I'd be struggling for sure.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not to mention after losing it, I'd have to make do with junk instead.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sometimes, people's wills just bend like paper, and what Bolívar's like now really doesn't help. If you told me this place was full of people with firm wills, I wouldn't believe you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It can't have been that smooth as first, but as time went on, nobody could stand up to reject it all. All of this has become some sort of status quo.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But I'll also acknowledge, for being able to decide straight from the start that this was how this city would come to manifest, this Mayor really is phenomenally powerful.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Powerful to the point that it's frightening.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There's a curve ahead. Do we take a shortcut?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No need. According to the map, we get the most shortcuts on the cycling section. If someone's going to try something, it'll probably be around then.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Don't forget, Ms. Candela has her underlings guarding the shortcuts. They're probably more dangerous than any dangerous terrorists.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If the other side didn't make a move during Round 1, I can only assume they'll be even more cautious during Round 2.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Mm. We'll see as things come.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come to mention it, Missy, does this MC seem familiar to you?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hm? Now that you say it, it's like I really have seen them somewhere before.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mmm. I feel like I've seen her somewhere, too.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: She's D.D.D., you know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: D.D.D.? Oh, now I remember. She's that real famous DJ, right? I saw a poster once.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's she doing here as a presenter, huh.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mm? Wait... Sideroca? What are you doing here? Out on a mission?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You could say that. It was a mission in Bolívar, helping Eyjafjalla with some geological research on the side. We heard there was a city here, and once we were all done, we put in for a vacation here.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How about you? Came with Ch'en?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, we came for a different reason.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You seem pretty in the know. You a music girl too?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Not really. A lot of operators are into her, and I've learned some things by osmosis. Right, you want to come over and sit with us?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What do you say, Missy?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Alright. I was getting a little bored of the competition anyway.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Eyjafjalla's here too?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Yep. She's out here so we can get her to relax for once.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wow, then that's perfect—I've never met her before. I intend to give her a proper hello.
